title: Egg muffins with vegetables and ham
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and lightly grease a 12-hole muffin tin.
Chop the pepper, ham and spring onions and roughly chop the spinach.
Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese, salt and pepper.
Divide the vegetables and ham between the holes and fill up with the egg mixture.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until set; eat warm or cold (4 per serving).
